high_level_description: stc brand style, an overhead view of four colleagues collaborating around a wooden table with a tablet showing a world map.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A grey wooden conference table with black office chairs, lit by purple-tinted studio lighting.

elements.desc: A man wearing a white thobe and a red-and-white checkered ghutra, typing on a laptop with a phone beside him.
